name: suspicious-activity-alert
title: Suspicious activity alert
description: A 'was this you?' alert for an unfamiliar sign-in, with device and place, and two clear answers: yes, or secure my account.
docs: event is { device, place, at, ip }: the IP address is hidden in part whatever you pass (203.0.x.x), and the place is called approximate. onConfirm (Yes, it was me) folds the alert away; onSecure (No, secure my account) runs and then shows the next steps, by default change your password and sign out other sessions. Pass steps with an href or an onSelect to make them buttons. Both callbacks may return promises and show a spinner, and a rejection is said in words. The alert is announced once as role="alert"; nothing takes the focus when it appears, the heading of the steps takes it after No, and a failed answer or step gives it back to the button that was pressed. defaultStep="secured" opens on the steps.
